description: This source file defines a FastAPI application with an endpoint for updating items. It includes a Pydantic model for item data validation and a route handling function.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with fields for name, description, price, and tax, including validation rules.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item = Body(embed=True))
methods.description: An asynchronous FastAPI route handler for the PUT request to update an item, receiving item ID from the path and item data from the request body.

ctags.name: price
ctags.pattern: /^    price: float = Field(gt=0, description="The price must be greater than zero")$/

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Item = Body(embed=True)):$/
